claims.statement: For a rank-two approximant with deleted smaller singular value at least b0 and perturbation operator norm tau<b0, the actual top-two deleted right singular space has sine distance at most tau/(b0-tau) from the deleted approximant row space.

Symmetric columnwise epsilon-fits to one two-plane plus two physical anchor rows of area kappa force one symmetric 2x2 latent quadratic form, up to row residual epsilon(1+5/kappa), with heavy-index remainder rank at most 2h.
If E is symmetric and every physical row has l2 norm at most eta, then the projection onto |lambda(E)|>=s has every physical leverage at most eta^2/s^2.

At the r48 live constants, unless a light original-coordinate self-star exceeds 1/64 or every light-light Pluecker anchor pair is below 1/64, each same-bank block decomposes as diagonal plus rank<=8 plus a symmetric residual whose |lambda|>=1/2 spectral projection has maximum coordinate leverage <1/32. Bilaterally, the aligned active-bank carrier has four latent directions plus interactions supported on at most six physical heavy coordinates; the genuine cross tail remains.
